name: 日落的城市
url: https://cdn.hailuoai.com/mcp/u483993072757477384/general/1779876009_692ec881.mp3
lyrics:
[主歌1]

走出门 风比中午凉

你听 城市的灯亮了

[主歌2]

公交站台 排着长长的队
有人在等 有人的士刚开
我站在这儿 数着路灯

[预副歌]

耳机里 播着老歌曲
暮色深 人行道空了

[副歌]

你听 城市的灯亮了
盏盏灯 好像晚来的信
你听 世界的光暖了

（轻声）
明天太阳 还会在
我走过的路 还会来

已经走远了

[Final Chorus]
你听 城市的灯亮了
盏盏灯 照亮晚归的人
你听 世界的光暖了
暮色里 我们各自回家

name: Eleven_Grey_Miles
url: https://cdn.hailuoai.com/mcp/u483993072757477384/general/1779872490_5a650e99.mp3
lyrics:
《Eleven Grey Miles》

**[Verse 1]**
The exit sign reads Maple Ridge, I haven't seen this road in years
The gas station's still here but the diner's gone
Your name's still on the mailbox, Mom packed it away in a box
I knock, she opens the door — smiles, then she doesn't

**[Pre-Chorus]**
And I drove eleven grey miles to say nothing at all
Just standing in her kitchen with my hands in my coat
She says "you're back" like a question, I nod like an answer
The coffee goes 寒冷, we both pretend

**[Chorus]**
Let it fall, let it fall — the roof's still leaking here
Let it burn, let it burn — I brought nothing to repair
We're fine, we're fine, she says from the doorway
But the wallpaper's peeling off the wall she shared with Dad

**[Verse 2]**
I walk past the elementary, the chains are gone from the swing set
Some kid left a shoe in the mud, still learning how to fall
I remember your jacket — red, the zipper broken
You said "I'll fix it tomorrow" — tomorrow never came

**[Pre-Chorus]**
And I drove eleven grey miles with a mouth full of glass
Every word I swallowed turned into gravel in my chest
She touches my shoulder, I feel the weight of her age
Like a house I've been abandoning for years

**[Chorus]**
Let it fall, let it fall — the roof's still leaking here
Let it burn, let it burn — I brought nothing to repair
We're fine, we're fine, she says from the doorway
But the wallpaper's peeling off the wall she shared with Dad

**[Bridge]**
I was gonna say "I missed you" — but the words came out wrong
I was gonna say "I'm sorry" — but I left it too long
Now the 光芒 in her kitchen is the last 光芒 on
And I'm standing in the driveway, watching the sun go down

**[Outro]**
Eleven grey miles, back the way I came
The exit sign disappears — I never say her name
I never say her name
I never say—

我翻过每一页 都是我们共同的光阴
